name: Cart drawer
description: A slide-over cart with a close button, line items, subtotal, a delivery reassurance line, and the two exit actions.

name: Cart line item
description: One row: thumb, title, variant summary, quantity stepper, line total, remove, plus the saved-for-later variant.

name: Empty cart
description: The zero state: icon, headline, a line of reassurance, a browse CTA, and a suggestion row to restart the shop.

name: Cart page
description: The full two-column cart: editable line items on the left, a sticky order summary card on the right.

name: Discount code
description: The code field with an apply button in three states: idle, an inactive code with its inline error, and the empty submit.

name: Delivery reassurance strip
description: Two quiet cards stating each delivery option and its window, in place of any spend-threshold nudge.

name: Checkout stepper
description: Details, delivery, payment and review, with complete, current and upcoming states. The current step carries aria-current="step".

name: Contact and delivery form
description: Email, phone, and a full Australian address block with a state select and a four-digit postcode, showing the valid and invalid states.

name: Shipping method selector
description: Radio cards carrying the method name, the delivery window, and the price, with a free standard option and a flat-rate express.

name: Payment section
description: A payment method radio group for card and PayPal, where the card fields reveal for the card option in CSS alone, with a security note underneath.

name: Express checkout row
description: The one-tap wallet row that sits above the form, with the divider that hands off to the long way round.

name: Order review
description: The last panel before the money moves: every earlier step collapsed with an edit link, the totals, consent, and the place-order button.

name: Order confirmation
description: The thank-you screen: order number, itemised recap, delivery address, estimated arrival, and where to go next.

name: Order tracking
description: A vertical timeline from ordered to delivered, carrying the tracking number and marking where the parcel is right now.
